repair.reason: Blocking finding B (D4 focused repair pass): #1440 requires counting EXPERIMENTS with a verified outcome, but the original implementation counted agent_org_proposals rows with outcome_status='verified' directly — including proposals with no experiment at all — which could inflate totalVerified and make the gate eligible incorrectly.
repair.fix: Removed AgentOrgProposalsRepository.countByOutcomeStatusAsync (became unused) and AgentOrgExperimentsRepository.countByDecisionAsync (superseded). Added AgentOrgExperimentsRepository.getTrustLedgerCountsAsync(), a single aggregate SQL query (agent_org_experiments JOIN agent_org_proposals) returning { totalVerified, totalRegressions } from one statement snapshot: totalVerified = COUNT of experiment rows whose proposal has outcome_status='verified'; totalRegressions = COUNT of experiment rows with decision='regress'. trust_counter_service.ts now calls only this one method instead of the two removed proposal/experiment counts. auto_promotion_enabled remains untouched/false throughout — recordEligibilityAsync's write path is unchanged.
repair.tests_added: trust_counter_service.test.ts: 'repair (blocking finding B): a verified proposal with no experiment does NOT count' and 'repair (blocking finding B): an experiment whose proposal is verified DOES count'. The pre-existing 10/0=>eligible, 10/1=>false, 9/0=>false cases were kept but their fixture (createVerifiedProposalAsync) was replaced with createVerifiedExperimentAsync, which declares a real experiment for each verified proposal — so those three cases now exercise real proposal+experiment pairs rather than bare proposals.
